summary: Iteration 7 — Announcement Bar feature tested end-to-end. All 10 backend tests + full frontend flow passed. Final admin state left enabled with offer style, 'Get 20% off your first test series', Explore -> /test-series, coupon WELCOME20, no dates.
critical_code_review_comments: AnnouncementBar.jsx client-side scheduling check uses local Date on an ISO string that already excludes active-window items server-side; harmless but double-filtering means if admin clock drifts behind server, UI may hide a server-active banner. Minor.
save_announcement uses 12-char hex version — fine; no DB index needed. Consider stripping cta_label/url when disabled (currently fields pass through unchanged, which is acceptable).
seed_data_creation: Announcement saved via API — enabled offer with WELCOME20 as required final state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Announcement feature complete. Dismissal uses localStorage 'ann_dismissed' = version string; invalidate by saving (new 12-char version). Public /api/site returns announcement only when enabled + within start/end window; otherwise null.
